pages.text: $(bold)Biting Frost$() (comes with Frozen Bone, $(bold)leveled$())$(br2)Effect: hits inflict $(bold)Frost$() on the enemy for $(bold)3 x level seconds$(), with a $(bold)6 second$() cooldown$(br2)Frost is this mod's status effect: while it lasts it keeps adding frozen ticks to the target (they really do get frozen solid), and it leaves a chill behind when it ends.$(br2)The cooldown is per $(bold)attacker$() (not per target), so you cannot freeze a whole crowd with one swing.$(br2)$(italic)Frozen through, it cuts faster than a blade.$()
